documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Board Meeting Intimation To Inter Alia Consider And Approve Unaudited Financial Statements For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement Under Regulation 30, SEBI (LODR) 2015 - Opening Of An Exclusive Brand Store At Amanora Mall, Hadapsar, Pune

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong operational and financial performance for Q4 and FY26, highlighting growth in revenue, gross profit, EBITDA, and average order values. The company outlined expansion plans via Exclusive Brand Outlets (EBOs) and Shop-in-Shops (SIS) funded through IPO proceeds, while maintaining an asset-light, low-capex retail model. They discussed store economics, raw material compositions, and industry tailwinds supporting branded natural diamond jewellery. Furthermore, management addressed questions regarding lab-grown diamonds, working capital, and long-term margins. PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Limited reported robust financial and operational growth for Q4 and FY26, driven by strong consumer demand and network expansion.

guidance.claim: The company expects a top-line growth of around 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: So I expect top-line growth also to get maintained around 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: Management expects same-store sales growth (SSG) to be around 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: SSG, I am expecting around 25% to 30%, it will not be less than 25% to 30%.

demand_outlook.claim: Diamonds are increasingly becoming relevant across occasions ranging from daily wear to weddings and gifting.
demand_outlook.quote: We believe diamonds are increasingly becoming relevant across occasions ranging from daily wear and work wear to celebration, weddings, and gifting.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian Gems and Jewellery Industry is projected to grow around INR15,000 billion by calendar year '29.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian Gem and Jewellery Industry is a large and growing market, currently valued at approximately INR10,000 plus billion and projected to grow around INR15,000 billion by calendar year '29.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add 15 new stores in a 24-month period, out of which one is already established.
capex_expansion.quote: Company has got plan to add 15 new stores which is mentioned, very well mentioned in DRHP, RHP, and prospectus, out of which one store is already established and overall this expansion of 15 stores will take place in a 24-month period.

capex_expansion.claim: Out of the 14 remaining stores, 6 to 7 will take place in the current financial year and the rest in the next financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: Out of these 14, 6 to 7 will take place in current financial year and remaining will be in next financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin for the quarter stood at 28%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit for quarter stood at INR38 crores reflecting growth of 195% Y-o-Y with gross profit margin at 28%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 22%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR31 crores recording growth of 278% Y-o-Y while EBITDA margin stood at 22%.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin for the quarter stood at 16%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR21 crores growing by 350% Y-o-Y while PAT margin stood at 16%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a current store count of 36 stores, consisting of two COCO stores and 34 SIS.
orders_capacity.quote: With the current store count of 36 stores, out of which two are the COCO stores and 34 are SIS, we are evolving aspirations of modern consumers through a well-curated portfolio of natural diamond jewellery across price points.

orders_capacity.claim: The average order value for FY26 is INR1,20,000, registering a Y-o-Y growth of 41%.
orders_capacity.quote: As far as current year ending for which we are referring the results, that is FY26, the average bill size value or average order value is INR1,20,000. Y-o-Y growth is 41%.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of INR380 crores raised through the IPO, INR287 crores are earmarked exclusively for store expansion and working capital requirements.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of that, INR287 crores proceeds are earmarked exclusively for the store expansion, working capital requirement.

capital_allocation.claim: Through the IPO, the company raised 380 crore for working capital requirements, expanding new retail stores, and strengthening its overall business infrastructure and brand presence.
capital_allocation.quote: Through the IPO, the company raised ₹380 crore, which it will primarily use for working capital requirements, expanding new retail stores, and strengthening its overall business infrastructure and brand presence.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that forward-looking statements are based on beliefs and expectations and are not a guarantee of future performance, involving unforeseen risks and uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: These statements are not a guarantee of the company's future performance and involve unforeseen risks and uncertainties.

management_commitments.claim: The expansion of 15 stores will take place over a 24-month period.
management_commitments.quote: Company has got plan to add 15 new stores which is mentioned, very well mentioned in DRHP, RHP, and prospectus, out of which one store is already established and overall this expansion of 15 stores will take place in a 24-month period.

management_commitments.claim: Out of the remaining 14 stores, 6 to 7 will open in the current financial year and the rest in the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Out of these 14, 6 to 7 will take place in current financial year and remaining will be in next financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a strategy centred on scaling the retail footprint through COCO stores, enhancing brand visibility, and expanding presence in high-potential markets.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, our strategy centres on scaling our retail footprint through COCO stores, enhancing brand visibility, and expanding our presence in high-potential markets.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
